message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 (helps bind) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2–3 cups |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |

**Basic assembly steps:**

1. **Cook the noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mixture**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat until all components are used, finishing with mozzarella on top.
5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25–35 min, or until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10 min before serving.

Feel free to tweak the quantities or add your favorite veggies—lasagna is wonderfully adaptable!
